description: Test gear for the rack: right-click any port on any module and clip on an instrument — an oscilloscope, a frequency analyser, a meter or a voltage injector — which then appears beside that port

inputs.text: One of the hidden jacks this module patches for itself, so a measured port carries a signal or a driven port receives one; the cable and its plugs are drawn nowhere

outputs.text: One of the hidden jacks this module patches for itself, so a measured port carries a signal or a driven port receives one; the cable and its plugs are drawn nowhere

notes: nothing on this panel is patched by hand; the module is placed in the rack and everything is done from the right-click menu of the port being measured
on an output only a mute or an attenuverter can be clipped on: the mute takes out every cable leaving it, and the attenuverter scales what arrives at each input it feeds
Widgets… appears in a port's right-click menu only while this module is in the rack and not bypassed; bypassing it hides every widget until it is unbypassed
menu: Show diagnostics… — opens a window measuring what this plugin costs on this machine, with each part of it switchable, for watching against Rack's own CPU meter
